whatIs.title: What is AI Image Layered Decomposition?
whatIs.description: joymagic's AI Image Layered tool, powered by advanced Qwen-Image-Layered technology, automatically analyzes a single image and decomposes it into multiple semantically independent RGBA layers (red, green, blue + alpha transparency).
whatIs.paragraph1: Unlike traditional segmentation that only gives masks, our AI:
points: Understands depth, occlusion, and scene structure
Generates clean, soft-edged alpha channels for each layer
Preserves correct layering order (foreground to background)
whatIs.paragraph2: Ideal for designers, illustrators, game developers, photo editors, and anyone who needs non-destructive, layer-based control over complex images.

howTo.title: How to Decompose an Image into Layers
howTo.description: Create editable layered compositions with our AI layered decomposition tool in just a few simple steps:

step1.title: Upload your image
step1.description:
Drag and drop or select your photo or artwork.
Supports JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP formats.

Works with photos, AI-generated art, illustrations, and scenes

step2.title: Set decomposition options
step2.description:
Customize the output:

Number of layers: Choose from 2 to 8 layers (default: 4)
Optional prompt: Add guidance like "separate person, furniture, background" for more precise control

step3.title: Generate layers
step3.description:
Click Decompose – our AI instantly analyzes and splits the image into layered RGBA outputs.

Real-time preview of each layer

step4.title: Preview and download
step4.description:
View individual layers with transparency.

Download as separate PNG files (with alpha)
Or get a layered PSD file (coming soon)
HD quality, ready for Photoshop, Procreate, or any editor

faq.title: AI Image Layered Decomposition FAQs
faq.description: Everything you need to know about our AI layered decomposition tool.

q1.question: What image formats are supported?
q1.answer: We support JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WEBP. Best results with clear, high-resolution images.

q2.question: How many layers can I generate?
q2.answer: You can select from 2 to 8 layers. More layers provide finer separation on complex scenes.

q3.question: Will my layers have clean transparency?
q3.answer: Yes. Each layer includes a professional soft-edged alpha channel for natural blending.

q4.question: Can I guide the decomposition with text?
q4.answer: Yes – add an optional prompt to prioritize certain objects or regions (e.g., "focus on person and table").

q5.question: What output formats are available?
q5.answer: Each layer is downloaded as a separate transparent PNG. Layered PSD export coming soon.

q6.question: Is my data safe?
q6.answer: Yes. Uploaded images are processed securely and automatically deleted after processing. We never use your images for training.

q7.question: Does it work on AI-generated or illustrated images?
q7.answer: Yes – excellent results on both photographic and artistic styles, including AI art.
